dataList.content:
Looks like everyone's getting more desperate. They're all cornered, just like us.
大概是因为人们现在都如履薄冰了吧，下手都越来越狠了。
dataList.place:
Evaluation Arena B2
评审场 地下2层

dataList.content:
Dammit, it's not like they're gonna win a ton of coins by coming after us!
呜……就算抢走我们这点儿铜钱也没什么用吧……！

Our best course of action now would be to take advantage of this situation. They're saving us the time by coming at us with their coins.
事已至此，我们也要全力以赴夺走对方的铜钱。

As we were descending and fighting off groups of enemies after enemies...
在我们应对不间断的袭击并向下推进的途中。

A loud bang of a firearm echoed from not too far across the hallway.
不远处传来一声低沉的枪响，

Lin Daiyu, who leaped in front of Hong Lu, falls to the ground.
迅速挡在鸿璐面前的林黛玉，踉跄着跌坐了下来。

Oh...
哎呀……

She was certainly not my intended target; forgive me. I am still acclimatizing to the use of this 'E.G.O'.
我不是有意而为。还请谅解。我目前对这E.G.O的熟练度还不够高。

It's never easy to aim right.
准确瞄准目标一直以来都不容易。

Daiyu, are ya... are ya alright? That's a pretty big wound...
黛玉小姐……你……你还好吗？这伤口……看着可不小……

I'm... alright...
我、我没事……

Daiyu... why?
黛玉……为什么？

Don't give me that look. It was just a force of habit.
请不要用那种眼神看我，是我的身体自己动了而已，哥哥。

Or have you already forgotten? I am from the Lin family, the family of bodyguards.
你忘了吗？我们林家世世代代都是侍卫出身……

My wounds can be rewound, Daiyu.
我是可以复原的，黛玉。

Unlike yours... You knew this.
和你不一样……你也知道吧。

I can use Hongyuan's Life Insurance anyway if that's what you are concerned about.
如果要这么说的话我也可以……使用鸿园的生命保险。

It won't work on someone who's been dead for too long.
如果死后的时间太长的话，生命保险是没用的。

And I don't—
而且我……

Hong Lu's eyes trembled briefly. My thoughts wandered to visions of Xiren's past, then to her present. Perhaps his did as well.
鸿璐的视线动摇了一瞬。他或许……是想到了很久以前的袭人。

... Perhaps I thought I could make amends for even a small fraction of the years of resentment I harbored for you.
……我觉得这样至少可以弥补一下这些年来对哥哥的愤恨。

Besides, I don't want to see you in pain.
而且我也不想看到哥哥痛苦的模样。

This is quite strange.
真是罕见。

Would anyone in the know care to explain to me why this wound on a different candidate's clan is causing such a stir?
不过是其他候选人的势力成员受伤而已，有必要这么慌吗？

Allow me to impart a word of advice. Do not be so hasty in forging fellowships.
听我一句劝，你们可别随便结交朋友。

For you might come across a fellow whom you had trusted to be a comrade who would build a future together, only for them to flit away without a word.
毕竟被你深信不疑为共勉未来的同伴，也可能会二话不说撒腿就跑。

You will not speak with such impudence, Gubo.
不可轻言，仇甫。

Our shared past is not to be a subject of your ridicule...!
我们的过去绝非任人轻语戏言之物……！

Of course... our recent exchanges tell me that you have learned to speak without letting the dirt on the ground draw the majority of your attention.
确实……昨天也是这样子，看来你现在可以不瞅着地面好好说话了。

But Yi Sang, I very much prefer your old self.
但是李箱，我更中意你以前的样子。

Now you are much too... let's see. Yes, much too slick. I can tell from your complete lack of hesitation in coming to your new fellow's defense.
现在的你……太过油滑了。若无其事地站在新友人身前的模样真碍眼。

So please, get out of my way. I do not wish to hit a wrong target again.
所以你差不多该让开了。下一枪我可不打算打偏。

There is no need, Gubo.
没有那个必要，仇甫。

Look at what hangs from my little brother's waist. There are barely any coins there. Now that's Baoyu, pride and joy of Daguanyuan, everyone.
看看我那令人骄傲的弟弟。还有他那些所剩无几的铜钱。

So you won't need to waste a bullet on that thing.
所以就算你向他射击，也没有任何意义。

It's simply embarrassing.
我看着都觉得丢人。

You dishonor the Jia family with your pathetic performance. We Jia deserve to be the very best of the four houses.
在四大家族中占有最高地位的贾家，在这里居然如此无力，真是令人痛心。

You talk as though you have already met every candidate from the Jia family, brother.
说得好像你已经见过了贾家的所有候选人一样啊，哥哥。

Yes, you could say that. I made sure that Jia Xichun would be eliminated soon enough.
对，确实是那样。贾惜春不久后也会被淘汰的。那都是我一手造成的。

A foolish pair they were, both master and her bodyguard. Not to mention the rest of her clan that may as well not exist.
不管是侍卫还是主人……都愚蠢至极。她那微不足道的势力也一样。

While others are giving the arms and legs of their followers to traps to scavenge as many coins as they can...
其他人为了多得到哪怕一枚铜钱，都断胳膊断腿地杀红了眼……

... she stubbornly chooses the straightforward, honest, and boring path... A privilege not availed to someone who's so low on coins.
而她明明一无所有，居然还在用最迂腐的方式老老实实地收集铜钱。

I was about to break her skull to end her suffering once and for all, but... tsk, she managed to give me the slip.
我本想打爆她的头……啧，可惜让她跑了。

Not too interested in improving our horrible first impression, is he?
这人和上次见面的时候差不太多啊，真招人厌。

Doesn't look like he's about to start a fight just yet, so let's administer some first aid for miss Daiyu here—
看起来他没有战斗的意愿，我们还是先帮黛玉小姐处理伤势……

No. No need.
不用。没有必要。

... The Heishou are here. That means...
是黑兽。他们的出现就意味着……

What a shame... the last remaining candidate of the Xue family is eliminated, but not before bringing such a dramatic defeat to the out-of-control Shi family candidate.
哎呀……那位出色地制服了暴走的史家候选人的薛家仅存的候选人，也被淘汰了。

Unfortunately, she wasted too much time in that fight and couldn't make it past the rising walls. If there are any clan members who have been separated from your candidate, please remain still where you are.
看来是因为耗费了太多时间导致没能及时越过墙壁。请淘汰的候选人与其附属势力不要移动，待在原地。

You... will soon be collected according to the procedures.
马上……就会有人来按照程序回收各位。

So, miss Baochai has been eliminated.
看来宝钗小姐被淘汰了。

... It seems that this is as far as I go.
……我好像也到此为止了。

Brief though this journey may have been, I am glad that we were able to resolve many misunderstandings.
这趟同行解开了诸多误会，实在是万幸。

Daiyu...
黛玉……

I will... wish you safe passage.
愿你……平安归来。

So please, do return this time.
这次，请一定要回来。

The game is racing to its end!
本次评审即将迎来尾声！

Let's try something unique this time to really enhance the experience, shall we? More immersion, more drama, more danger~!
为了进一步营造紧张与危险的氛围，我们打算弄出一些特殊情况~

Something like... let's see. What if we corralled the top three candidates into the same room...?
如果……让前三名的候选人共处一室面面相对的话……

The candidates' placements seem pretty concrete now, don't they? But can we shake that up somehow, in the greatest turnabout of history?!
已成定局的排名！说不定会发生惊天大逆转呢？

Games with predictable endings~ can get pretty boring for our dearest spectators.
毕竟大局已定的胜负~会让各位观众感到无聊。

<Which means...?>
<这话也就是说……>

Let's review the current rankings, shall we? First, Jia Qiu of the Jia family! Second, Jia Huan of the Jia family! Third, Jia... Baoyu of the Jia family!
统计一下目前的铜钱数量的话……第一名是贾家的贾丘，第二名是贾家的贾环，第三名是贾家的……贾宝玉！

... They're going to put us in the same room as them?
……要让我们和那些人在一起当面对峙吗？

Are we about to witness a turnabout? Is it even possible? Well, we'll find out soon enough!
究竟是否会发生惊天大逆转呢？大门已然开启。

Haah...
哈……

Now isn't this interesting.
真有趣。

If you've made it to third place with those paltry coins, then... the first place must've really been hoarding all the coins for himself.
那点铜钱就能位居第三名……看来第一名攒了不少铜钱啊……

Allow me to enter first, little brother. I'd loathe to display even the faintest semblance of amity with you.
弟弟。我可不想跟你一起友好入场，先走一步了。

Although, I wouldn't mind if you would make a correct assessment of your limitations and drop out of the game now.
你要是能对自己的上限有点自知之明，早点主动出局的话就再好不过了。

... Turnabout?
……大逆转？

What even is the point of this 'turnabout'...? Isn't it just another way to make the show more interesting for the viewers to enjoy?
说得倒是好听……归根结底就是为了让那些观众看得更有兴致吧。

If we come in third place... considering that they're also likely shooting for the Golden Bough, we are almost guaranteed to lose our objective to them.
虽然我们是第三名……但那些人也是冲着金枝来的，在这种情况下肯定会错失金枝。

Okay...
但是……

So how the hell are we going to beat that Jia Qiu guy...?
我们何德何能，既要战胜贾丘……

Especially with Jia Huan breathing down our necks?
还要对付贾环……

But... we have no other choice, do we?
但是……也没有别的办法了吧？

If there's no way out, then our only path is inward.
既然无路可退，那就只能前进了呢。

Oi, you sure about this?
喂，你没事吧？

Both of 'em waiting for you in there, they...
我们接下来要在那里面对的那些家伙……

They...
可是会把你……

Heathcliff trailed off.
希斯克利夫把话咽了回去。

Neither of them are even remotely fond of Hong Lu, so they are likely going to go all-out on trying to kill him. Heathcliff knew that.
因为他知道，贾丘和贾环都对鸿璐有所不满，所以很显然他们都会全力应战。

Big brother Qiu must be waiting for me in there.
想必丘大哥已经在那里面等我了。

Brother Qiu... followed his father's last name, but he was pretty much a part of the Kong family. He survived only because he happened to be away on the day of the Kong family's ruin.
丘大哥是在孔家灭门之日当天偶然缺席的……孔家人。他是随父姓得到了贾家的姓氏。

He found out only after he returned. Both his mother from the Kong family and his father from the Jia family were killed in that bloodbath, and... he didn't even have a single, close relative left.
当他回到家中时，不光是他孔家的母亲，甚至连贾家的父亲也被卷入其中惨遭变故……此外，他还失去了所有曾与他朝夕相处的亲戚们。

What welcomed him upon his return were the empty ruins of this building, the silence of the Daguanyuan people, and the tale of the Kong family's disgraceful greed, and how it destroyed them.
丘大哥看到的……只剩下空空如也的残垣断壁，与大观园闭口不言的人们，以及孔家留下了心怀可耻贪欲之污名的故事。

Some servants warned me that brother Qiu might come to take my life, as anyone could guess that I probably had something to do with that day.
下人们……偶尔会跟我说，丘大哥说不定会找到我这个可能与孔家灭门之日有所关联的人，并加害于我。

But he never came to find me. He simply left Daguanyuan, then Hongyuan.
但丘大哥从未找来我这里，他只是就这样离开了鸿园……以及这大观园。

So... the fact that he has returned...
所以他再次回到这里……

... must be proof of his indefatigable determination and will.
一定是下了莫大的决心，并抱有绝不退缩的意志。

Of course, I wouldn't... know what that's like.
尽管我不知道……那究竟是什么。
